create_differentiable_robot_model: create a DifferentiableRobotModel from a URDF file path for differentiable robot simulation
compute_forward_kinematics: compute forward kinematics to get translation and rotation of a robot link given joint angles
compute_inverse_dynamics: compute inverse dynamics to get joint forces needed to achieve desired accelerations

compute_endeffector_jacobian: compute the linear and angular Jacobian of a robot end-effector link given joint angles
